item.title: LeetCode: Solve Algorithm and Data Structure Problems
item.description: Algorithms are used in every part of computer science. They form the field’s backbone. In computer science, an algorithm gives the computer a specific set of instructions, which allows the computer to do everything, be it running a calculator or running a rocket.
